## [CN]三部分对应的 API
## [EN]The API for each part

| 需求 | API | 说明 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 选中时显示不同标题（「首页」→「刷新」） | `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle`（本次新增） | Tab 选中时显示该标题，选中其他 Tab 后恢复 `CYLTabBarItemTitle`。 |
| 选中时显示不同图标（刷新图标） | `CYLTabBarItemSelectedImage`（已有） | 选中图片。 |
| 再次点击播放动画 | `CYLTabBarLottieFilePath` / `CYLTabBarLottieURL`（已有） | 点击已选中的 Tab 时，Lottie 动画会重新播放。 |
| 再次点击刷新 | `cyl_tabBarItemGestureHandler` 的 `CYLTabBarItemGestureReselect`（见 [TabBarItem-Gestures.md](TabBarItem-Gestures.md)） | 点击已选中的 Tab 时回调，在其中刷新页面。 |

| Need | API | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| A different title while selected ("Home" → "Refresh") | `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle` (new) | Shown while the tab is selected; `CYLTabBarItemTitle` comes back when another tab is selected. |
| A different icon while selected (a refresh icon) | `CYLTabBarItemSelectedImage` (existing) | The selected image. |
| An animation on a re-tap | `CYLTabBarLottieFilePath` / `CYLTabBarLottieURL` (existing) | Tapping the selected tab replays its Lottie animation. |
| Refresh on a re-tap | `CYLTabBarItemGestureReselect` of `cyl_tabBarItemGestureHandler` (see [TabBarItem-Gestures.md](TabBarItem-Gestures.md)) | Called on a tap on the selected tab; refresh the page there. |

## [CN]用法
## [EN]Usage

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 在 `tabBarItemsAttributes` 中为需要的 Tab 加上 `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle`，其他 Tab 不受影响。 | Add `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle` to the attributes of the tabs that need it; the other tabs are unchanged. |

### Objective-C

```objc
NSDictionary *homeTabBarItemsAttributes = @{
    CYLTabBarItemTitle : @"Home",                      // 普通标题 / normal title
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle : @"Refresh",           // 选中标题 / title while selected (#433)
    CYLTabBarItemImage : @"home_normal",
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedImage : @"home_refresh",      // 选中图标，例如刷新图标 / selected icon, e.g. a refresh icon
    CYLTabBarLottieFilePath : [[NSBundle mainBundle] pathForResource:@"tab_home" ofType:@"json"], // 再次点击重播 / replays on a re-tap
};

// 再次点击刷新 / refresh on a re-tap (#152)
__weak __typeof(self) weakSelf = self;
self.cyl_tabBarItemGestureHandler = ^(CYLTabBarController *tabBarController, CYLTabBarItemGesture gesture,
                                      UIControl *control, UIViewController *viewController) {
    if (gesture == CYLTabBarItemGestureReselect) {
        [weakSelf refreshViewController:viewController];
    }
};
```

### Swift

```swift
let home: [AnyHashable: Any] = [
    CYLTabBarItemTitle: "Home",
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle: "Refresh",   // #433
    CYLTabBarItemImage: "home_normal",
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedImage: "home_refresh",
]
```

| Objective-C Demo 的 `MainTabBarController`：「首页」Tab 设置了 `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle : CYLLocalizedString(@"刷新")`，选中时显示「刷新」（英文环境为 "Refresh"），切换到其他 Tab 后恢复「首页」；再次点击会重播 Lottie 动画，并由 `cyl_tabBarItemGestureHandler` 滚动到顶部，双击则刷新。 | The Objective-C demo's `MainTabBarController`: the "Home" tab has `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle : CYLLocalizedString(@"刷新")`, so it reads "Refresh" while selected and "Home" again when another tab is selected; a re-tap replays its Lottie animation and `cyl_tabBarItemGestureHandler` scrolls to the top, a double tap refreshes. |

## [CN]注意事项
## [EN]Notes

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 选中标题在以下时机更新：控制器显示时（`-viewWillAppear:`）、用户点击 Tab、代码设置 `selectedIndex` / `selectedViewController`。只处理设置了 `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle` 的 Tab，没有设置时行为不变。 | The selected title is updated when the controller appears (`-viewWillAppear:`), on a tap on a tab, and when `selectedIndex` / `selectedViewController` is set in code. Only tabs with a `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle` are touched; without it nothing changes. |
| 经典样式与液态玻璃通过 `tabBarItem.title` 修改标题（同时修改导航控制器根控制器的 `tabBarItem`）；扁平样式修改 `CYLFlatDesignTabBarItem.title`。 | The classic style and Liquid Glass change `tabBarItem.title` (and the one of the navigation controller's root view controller); FlatDesign changes `CYLFlatDesignTabBarItem.title`. |
| 普通标题取自 `CYLTabBarItemTitle`。如需修改普通标题或选中标题，请使用 `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:`（或 `-updateTabBarItemsWithAttributes:`）传入 `CYLTabBarItemTitle` / `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle`，选中的 Tab 会立即显示新的选中标题；`-replaceViewControllerAtIndex:withViewController:attributes:` 与 `-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` 同样支持。不要直接修改该 Tab 的 `tabBarItem.title`（切换选中时会被恢复为 `CYLTabBarItemTitle`）。 | The normal title is taken from `CYLTabBarItemTitle`. To change the normal or the selected title, pass `CYLTabBarItemTitle` / `CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle` to `-updateTabBarItemAtIndex:attributes:` (or `-updateTabBarItemsWithAttributes:`); the selected tab shows its new selected title right away. `-replaceViewControllerAtIndex:withViewController:attributes:` and `-reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes:` take them too. Do not set that tab's `tabBarItem.title` directly (it goes back to `CYLTabBarItemTitle` when the selection changes). |
| 选中标题与普通标题长度差异较大时，TabBar 布局会随之变化；建议两者长度相近。 | When the two titles differ much in length, the tab bar layout changes with them; keep them about the same length. |
| PlusButton 没有 `CYLTabBarItemTitle` 属性，选中标题请使用 `+[CYLPlusButton cyl_plusButtonWithImage:title:selectedTitle:selectedTitleColor:]`。 | The plus button has no `CYLTabBarItemTitle` attributes; for its selected title use `+[CYLPlusButton cyl_plusButtonWithImage:title:selectedTitle:selectedTitleColor:]`. |

```objc
// 例如切换语言后 / e.g. after the app's language changed
[tabBarController updateTabBarItemAtIndex:0 attributes:@{
    CYLTabBarItemTitle : CYLLocalizedString(@"首页"),
    CYLTabBarItemSelectedTitle : CYLLocalizedString(@"刷新"),
}];
```
